title.en: An IDN homograph attack awareness demo
title.zh: IDN 同形異義字攻擊的教學 demo

description.en: A single-page, bilingual demo that shows how a Cyrillic letter can pass for a Latin one in a link, what the browser really opens, and how to defend against it.
description.zh: 單頁、中英雙語的教學 demo：示範一個西里爾字母如何在連結裡冒充拉丁字母、瀏覽器實際連到哪裡，以及該怎麼防。

eyebrow.zh: 資安宣導 · 單頁 demo

lede.en: An IDN homograph attack swaps a letter in a domain for a lookalike from another script, such as Cyrillic а for Latin a. This demo lets coworkers see it for themselves, then shows how the trick is used and how to defend against it.
lede.zh: IDN 同形異義字攻擊，是把網域裡的字母換成其他文字裡長得一模一樣的字母，例如用西里爾字母 а 取代拉丁字母 a。這個 demo 讓同事親眼看一次，再說明攻擊者怎麼利用、又該怎麼防。

title.zh: 拉丁字母 vs 西里爾字母

meta.en: The five pairs in the demo's character table
meta.zh: demo 字元對照表裡的五組字母

title.en: The link text looks right. The domain is not.
title.zh: 看起來一樣，網域卻不同。

body.en: Domain names can contain letters from many scripts, and browsers convert those names to an ASCII form that starts with xn-- (Punycode, RFC 3492). An attacker registers a name that swaps one Latin letter for its Cyrillic twin. People see the familiar spelling; the computer sees different code points and connects to a different domain.
body.zh: 網域名稱可以包含各種文字的字母，瀏覽器會把這類名稱轉成以 xn-- 開頭的 ASCII 形式（Punycode，RFC 3492）。攻擊者註冊一個把某個拉丁字母換成西里爾「雙胞胎」的網域：人眼看到的是熟悉的拼法，電腦看到的卻是不同的碼位，連到的也是另一個網域。

quote.en: User vigilance alone cannot defend against this.
quote.zh: 單純靠使用者警覺，幾乎不可能防禦。

title.en: Guess, click, then trace the chain.
title.zh: 先猜，再點，最後看完整條攻擊鏈。

intro.en: The page works like a short live session. It opens with a question and closes with a checklist.
intro.zh: 整個頁面就像一堂簡短的現場課：從一個問題開始，用一份清單收尾。

body.en: Two links that read the same. The first uses the Latin a (U+0061); the second swaps in the Cyrillic а (U+0430).
body.zh: 兩個看起來一樣的連結。第一個用的是拉丁字母 a（U+0061），第二個換成了西里爾字母 а（U+0430）。

body.en: Click the second link and the address bar shows an xn-- Punycode name, and the browser may warn you. The fake link is not meant to load.
body.zh: 點第二個連結，網址列會出現 xn-- 開頭的 Punycode 名稱，瀏覽器也可能跳出警告。假連結本來就不會正常開啟。

body.en: The demo's own seven-step reconstruction of the Booking.com “reservation hijack” scams that the BBC reported in April 2026: stolen hotel logins, guest data, a message posing as the hotel, and a lookalike payment link.
body.zh: demo 自己整理的七步攻擊鏈，對應 BBC 在 2026 年 4 月報導的 Booking.com「訂房劫持」詐騙：飯店後台帳密被偷、房客資料外流、有人冒充飯店傳訊息，最後附上一個仿冒的付款連結。

body.en: A character table explains why the eye cannot tell the difference, and a checklist covers what people and security teams can do.
body.zh: 用字元對照表說明為什麼肉眼分不出來，再用一份清單整理個人與資安團隊各自能做的事。

title.en: What the demo teaches people to do.
title.zh: 這個 demo 要教的事。

intro.en: Taken from the demo's closing section. The first five are habits anyone can keep; the last one is for security and IT teams.
intro.zh: 整理自 demo 的最後一段。前五項是每個人都做得到的習慣，最後一項是給資安與 IT 團隊的。

title.zh: 看網址最右邊的根網域

body.en: Check the root domain at the right end of the address, not the words in front of it. secure-example.com is not example.com.
body.zh: 檢查網址最右邊的根網域，不要被前面那串字騙了。secure-example.com 不是 example.com。

title.en: Notice xn-- in the address bar

body.en: A lookalike name often shows up as xn-- Punycode. When the browser shows that form instead of the familiar spelling, its homograph protection is working.
body.zh: 仿冒網域常會以 xn-- 開頭的 Punycode 顯示。瀏覽器不顯示熟悉的拼法、改顯示這種形式，就代表它的同形字防護正在運作。

title.en: Never log in or pay from a message
title.zh: 不從訊息裡的連結登入或付款

body.en: Open the app, type the address, or use a bookmark. Any message that asks for a wire transfer is almost always a scam.
body.zh: 自己打開 App、手動輸入網址，或用書籤。任何要求銀行轉帳的訊息，幾乎都是詐騙。

title.en: Turn on MFA, ideally a passkey

body.en: With multi-factor authentication, a stolen password alone does not get in. FIDO2 keys and passkeys also resist credential phishing.
body.zh: 有了多因素驗證，只偷到密碼也登不進去。FIDO2 金鑰與 passkey 還能抵擋帳密釣魚。

body.en: Chrome, Edge, and Firefox ship an IDN display policy for homograph detection. Staying current keeps that check working.
body.zh: Chrome、Edge、Firefox 都內建 IDN 顯示政策來偵測同形字，保持更新，這道檢查才會持續有效。

body.en: Defensive domain registration, DMARC, SPF, and DKIM, DNS monitoring, and regular phishing drills. A SOC can watch newly registered and Punycode domains and scan for brand lookalikes with dnstwist.
body.zh: 防禦性註冊網域、DMARC / SPF / DKIM、DNS 監控與定期釣魚演練。SOC 可以監控新註冊的網域與 Punycode 網域，並用 dnstwist 掃描仿冒自家品牌的變體。

intro.en: Preview it locally, then deploy your own copy. vercel.json adds security headers and keeps the page out of search results.
intro.zh: 先在本機預覽，再部署自己的版本。vercel.json 會加上安全標頭，並讓頁面不被搜尋引擎收錄。

body.en: Open index.html in a browser. Or clone the repository, serve the folder, and visit http://localhost:8000.
body.zh: 直接用瀏覽器開啟 index.html；或 clone repo 後在資料夾裡啟動本機伺服器，再開 http://localhost:8000。

body.en: The first deploy of a new project goes straight to production. After that, vercel makes a preview and vercel --prod updates production.
body.zh: 新專案第一次部署會直接上正式環境；之後執行 vercel 只會產生預覽版，要更新正式版請用 vercel --prod。

body.en: Import the repository at vercel.com/new with Framework Preset Other and empty build settings, or drop the folder on vercel.com/drop.
body.zh: 在 vercel.com/new 匯入 repo，Framework Preset 選 Other、建置設定留空；或直接把資料夾拖到 vercel.com/drop。

intro.en: Written in April 2026 as a study note for showing coworkers the attack, and changed in October 2026 to use a fictional bank. Small and finished, and the Vercel copy is still live.
intro.zh: 2026 年 4 月寫給同事看的學習筆記，2026 年 10 月改用虛構的銀行當範例。規模小、內容已完成，Vercel 上的版本仍在線上。

works.en: One index.html with a 中文 / English toggle and no build step
works.zh: 單一 index.html，可切換中文 / English，不需要建置

works.en: Live experiment, seven-step kill chain, character table, and defense checklist
works.zh: 現場實驗、七步攻擊鏈、字元對照表與防禦清單

works.en: vercel.json sends nosniff, frame DENY, no-referrer, and noindex headers
works.zh: vercel.json 會送出 nosniff、禁止被嵌入框架（DENY）、no-referrer 與 noindex 標頭
2026-09-30 確認線上 demo 正常回應

limits.en: The example domain and branding are hard-coded in several places; adapting the demo means editing them by hand and recomputing the Punycode string
limits.zh: 範例網域與品牌寫死在好幾個地方，要改成自己的版本，得手動修改，並重新計算 Punycode 字串

limits.en: The fake link is not meant to load; expect an error page or a browser block
limits.zh: 假連結本來就不會正常開啟，會看到錯誤頁或被瀏覽器擋下

limits.en: The $2,000 and 580% figures in the kill chain are not in the linked BBC article and were not verified here
limits.zh: 攻擊鏈裡的 2,000 美元與 580% 這兩個數字，不在所附的 BBC 文章裡，這裡也沒有查證

heading.zh: 為什麼字母看起來一樣

intro.en: The fake link swaps one letter for a Cyrillic lookalike. The demo's table lists five pairs.
intro.zh: 假連結把一個字母換成西里爾字母的形近字。Demo 的對照表列出五組。

note.en: The real link uses U+0061 for the first a in examplebank.example.
note.zh: 正牌連結 examplebank.example 的第一個 a 是 U+0061。

note.en: The fake href writes U+0430 in that same spot, and the page does not encode it first.
note.zh: 假連結的 href 在同一個位置直接寫 U+0430，頁面沒有先把它編碼。

note.en: The table marks a/а, c/с, e/е, o/о, and p/р as identical on screen.
note.zh: 對照表把 a/а、c/с、e/е、o/о、p/р 都標成螢幕上看起來一樣。

note.en: The labels differ by one code point, so they are different names under .example.
note.zh: 兩個標籤差一個碼位，所以是 .example 底下兩個不同的名稱。

caption.en: The real link's a is Latin U+0061. The fake link's first a is Cyrillic U+0430, written directly in the href. The demo's table says those glyphs look identical, and it says the same for c and с (U+0441), e and е (U+0435), o and о (U+043E), and p and р (U+0440). Different code points mean two different labels.
caption.zh: 正牌連結的 a 是拉丁字母 U+0061。假連結的第一個 a 是西里爾字母 U+0430，直接寫在 href 裡。Demo 的對照表說這兩個字形看起來一樣，c 和 с（U+0441）、e 和 е（U+0435）、o 和 о（U+043E）、p 和 р（U+0440）也一樣。碼位不同，就是兩個不同的標籤。

intro.en: The page does not compute this. The browser converts the label with Punycode, RFC 3492, when it uses the name.
intro.zh: 頁面自己不算這段。瀏覽器要用這個名稱時，才用 Punycode（RFC 3492）轉換標籤。

note.en: The fake host is ex, then U+0430, then mplebank, and the suffix .example stays a separate label.
note.zh: 假的主機名稱是 ex、U+0430、mplebank，後綴 .example 是另一個標籤。

note.en: Punycode copies the ASCII letters in order and leaves that Cyrillic letter out of this part, which produces exmplebank.
note.zh: Punycode 依序抄下 ASCII 字母，這一段不含那個西里爾字母，所以得到 exmplebank。

note.en: After a hyphen, the rest of the label records the removed character and its position, which is the suffix 0qi for this name.
note.zh: 連字號後面的部分記下被拿掉的字和它的位置，這個名稱的後綴是 0qi。

note.en: IDNA adds the ACE prefix xn-- to that label only, so the host is xn--exmplebank-0qi.example.
note.zh: IDNA 只在該標籤前加上 ACE 前綴 xn--，所以主機名稱是 xn--exmplebank-0qi.example。

ticks.zh: 主機名稱以 xn-- 開頭

caption.en: The browser does not send the Cyrillic letter to DNS as that character. It keeps the ASCII letters exmplebank, encodes the missing letter and its position as 0qi, and prefixes xn-- on that label only. The host is xn--exmplebank-0qi.example. The static page states this result and does not run an encoder.
caption.zh: 瀏覽器不會把那個西里爾字母原樣送給 DNS。它保留 ASCII 字母 exmplebank，把缺的字和位置編成 0qi，並只在該標籤前加上 xn--。主機名稱是 xn--exmplebank-0qi.example。靜態頁面寫出這個結果，自己並沒有執行編碼器。

heading.en: What a click is meant to show

intro.en: Both links are real anchors in index.html. Neither is meant to open a site.
intro.zh: 兩個連結都是 index.html 裡的真連結。它們都不該打開一個網站。

note.en: The question asks which link is fake, and the badges already say Real and Fake in both languages.
note.zh: 問題問哪一個是假的，徽章已經用兩種語言標成正牌和假的。

note.en: The second anchor's href is the Unicode lookalike, with rel noopener and target _blank.
note.zh: 第二個連結的 href 是 Unicode 形近名稱，並帶有 rel noopener 和 target _blank。

note.en: The page says the address bar shows the xn-- host, and that the browser may warn.
note.zh: 頁面說明網址列會顯示 xn-- 主機名稱，瀏覽器也可能出現警告。

note.en: Both names use .example, which RFC 2606 reserves, so they are not registered and do not resolve.
note.zh: 兩個名稱都用 .example，RFC 2606 保留這個頂級網域，所以無法註冊，也不會解析。

ticks.en: bar is expected to show xn--

caption.en: The demo shows two anchors that look the same and are already labeled Real and Fake. Clicking the fake one is expected to show xn--exmplebank-0qi.example in the address bar, and possibly a browser warning. Some browsers also show the xn-- form in the link text itself. Both names are reserved, so the error page is the intended result.
caption.zh: Demo 顯示兩個看起來一樣的連結，而且已經標成正牌和假的。點假的那個，網址列預期會出現 xn--exmplebank-0qi.example，瀏覽器也可能警告。有些瀏覽器連連結文字都顯示 xn--。兩個名稱都是保留名稱，所以錯誤頁就是預期的結果。

intro.en: The link text can show a familiar spelling while the request uses a different host.
intro.zh: 連結文字可以顯示熟悉的拼法，實際請求卻是另一個主機名稱。

note.en: The visible text of the fake link is the lookalike spelling, which matches the real name to the eye.
note.zh: 假連結畫面上的文字是形近拼法，肉眼看起來和正牌名稱相同。

note.en: The demo says to watch for the xn-- form, and its checklist names the IDN display policy in Chrome, Edge, and Firefox.
note.zh: Demo 要你留意 xn-- 形式，它的清單也寫了 Chrome、Edge、Firefox 的 IDN 顯示政策。

note.en: A resolved request would use xn--exmplebank-0qi.example, and in this demo the name does not resolve.
note.zh: 若這個名稱能解析，請求會使用 xn--exmplebank-0qi.example；在這個 demo 裡它不會解析。

ticks.en: text can match the real name

caption.en: A reader can see a spelling that matches the real example while the host in the request is the Punycode name. The dashed line is the browser IDN display the demo tells you to watch. This demo's names never resolve, because .example is reserved.
caption.zh: 讀者可能看到和正牌範例相同的拼法，請求裡的主機名稱卻是 Punycode。虛線是 Demo 要你看的瀏覽器 IDN 顯示。這個 demo 的名稱不會解析，因為 .example 是保留網域。
